intro: One row per lot. Only Name is required; leave anything that does not apply empty. Photos can be web links or file names saved in the same folder as this file, as many as you like. The three example rows are left out when you import, so you can keep them or delete them.

columns.help: The lot name buyers see. Required.
One or more, separated by commas. The first is the main one. Spelled like your existing categories where possible.
Brands and styles, separated by commas. These only filter; they never pick a newsletter audience.
A short summary buyers will see.
Pick one, or type your own.
Where the load ships FOB, as City, ST.
Units in the whole load, or units on each pallet when Quantity is says Per pallet. Leave empty when the variants carry the counts.
How many pallets.
The whole load, or Per pallet. Per pallet multiplies the quantity by the pallets.
Only for a quoted range per pallet, like 450 to 500. Put 450 in Quantity and 500 here.
Yes when the quantity is a minimum, shown as 20,000+.
Only to split the lot. The option names, separated by commas, like Color, Size.

One entry per combination, separated by semicolons: the values in the same order as the options, separated by /, then a colon, the units, and optionally at and a per-unit price. Black / M: 600 at 4.75; Navy / M: 500
Total retail value of the whole load.
Per unit, Fixed total (the whole load), Per pallet, or Custom text.
The number for the price type: per unit, for the whole load, or for one pallet.
Only when Price type is Custom text. Shown to buyers as written, up to 80 characters.
The fewest units a buyer can take.
Price breaks per unit, separated by semicolons: 2000+ at 4.00; 5000+ at 3.50
Yes shows a Make an offer form on your storefront.
Days until it comes off your site and is archived, counted from when it is added or last renewed. Leave empty to keep it up until you take it down. Up to 365.
As many as you like: web links, or file names in the same folder as this file. One per line, or separated by commas or semicolons. The first is the cover photo.
A link or file name for the manifest (PDF, CSV or Excel).
Anything else about the lot, like Authentic, sealed, minor box damage.
Yes if you already sent it on WhatsApp.
Yes if you already emailed it.
Private. Never shown to buyers.
Private. What you paid for the whole load. On a lot priced per unit it is worked out per unit for you.
Private. Only when you know what each unit cost rather than the whole load.
